fullPassage: Tree transplant shock is a condition that occurs when a tree undergoes stress or trauma after being moved to a new location. Symptoms of tree transplant shock include slower growth, which can potentially lead to death. Removed from its original location, a young tree can be expected to retain only about 15% of its root system. This reduces its ability to absorb water and nutrients from the soil. There are, however, ways to deal with this, such as transplanting only trees that are native to the region. Better suited to deal with the local climate and soils, these trees will develop new roots more quickly. Both before and after the transplant, be sure to provide the tree with plenty of water. Once successfully transplanted, the tree will require regular watering until it has become firmly established in its new location.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) slower=더 느린 / faster=더 빠른 (B) absorb=흡수하다 / release=방출하다 (C) quickly=빠르게 / slowly=느리게
det.analysis:
① faster—absorb—quickly: (A) 이식 쇼크의 증상은 '더 느린(slower)' 성장이지 더 빠른 성장이 아님
② slower—absorb—quickly: 느린 성장 + 물·영양분 흡수 + 새 뿌리를 더 빠르게 발달 ←정답
③ slower—release—slowly: (B)(C) 뿌리는 물을 '흡수(absorb)'하고, 토종 나무는 뿌리를 '빠르게(quickly)' 발달시킴
④ faster—release—quickly: (A)(B) 문맥과 반대
det.tip: 이식 쇼크 증상=slower(더 느린) 성장, 뿌리는 물을 absorb(흡수), 토종 나무는 quickly(빠르게) 새 뿌리 발달

② (A) 조건 (B) 상태, 질환: (A)를 '조건'으로 보면 이식 쇼크라는 병적 상태와 안 맞음
③ (A) 상태, 질환 (B) 상태, 질환: (B)는 계약에서 '반드시 받아들여야 할 조건'이라 '질환'이 아님
④ (A) 조건 (B) 조건: (A)가 부적절
det.tip: condition의 다의어: 병적 '상태·질환' vs 반드시 지켜야 할 '조건'

questions.stem: 다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은? "a substance that living things need in order to grow and stay healthy"

det.korean: climate=기후 / symptom=증상 / region=지역 / nutrient=영양분
det.analysis:
① climate: 기후 — 날씨의 장기 상태
② symptom: 증상 — 병의 신호
③ region: 지역 — 특정 구역
④ nutrient: 영양분 — 생물이 자라고 건강을 유지하는 데 필요한 물질 ←정답
det.tip: living things need + grow + stay healthy = 영양분(nutrient)

questions.passage: There are ways to deal with this, such as transplanting only trees that are native to the region. Better __________ (suit) to deal with the local climate and soils, these trees will develop new roots more quickly.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: suit(동사: 적합하게 하다) → suited (과거분사, 수동 분사구문: ~에 더 적합해서). 'Being better suited ~'에서 Being이 생략된 분사구문
det.analysis: 동사 suit을 과거분사 suited로 바꿔요. 'Better suited to ~'는 원래 'Being better suited to ~'에서 Being이 생략된 수동 분사구문이에요. '(이 나무들은) 지역 기후와 토양에 더 적합해서'라는 뜻으로, 나무가 '적합하게 되어진' 수동 관계라 과거분사 suited가 필요해요.
det.tip: 문장 앞 분사구문 + 수동(~에 적합하게 되어진) → 과거분사 suited

questions.passage: Both before and after the transplant, be sure to provide the tree with plenty of water. Once __________ (success) transplanted, the tree will require regular watering until it has become firmly established in its new location.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: success(명사: 성공) → successfully (부사: 성공적으로). 뒤의 과거분사 transplanted를 꾸미는 부사 자리
det.analysis: 명사 success를 부사 successfully로 바꿔요. 'Once __________ transplanted'에서 빈칸은 뒤의 과거분사 transplanted(옮겨 심어진)를 꾸미는 자리예요. 동사·분사를 꾸미는 것은 부사이므로 successfully(성공적으로)가 맞아요. '일단 성공적으로 옮겨 심어지면'이라는 뜻이에요.
det.tip: 분사(transplanted)를 꾸미는 자리 → 부사 successfully(-ly)

questions.passage: Tree transplant shock is a condition that occurs when a tree undergoes stress or trauma after being moved to a new location. Symptoms of tree transplant shock include slower growth, which can potentially __________. Removed from its original location, a young tree can be expected to retain only about 15% of its root system. This reduces its ability to absorb water and nutrients from the soil. There are, however, ways to deal with this, such as transplanting only trees that are native to the region. Better suited to deal with the local climate and soils, these trees will develop new roots more quickly. Both before and after the transplant, be sure to provide the tree with plenty of water. Once successfully transplanted, the tree will require regular watering until it has become firmly established in its new location.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: speed up growth=성장을 가속하다 / lead to death=죽음으로 이어지다 / improve health=건강을 개선하다 / attract insects=곤충을 끌어들이다
det.analysis:
① speed up growth: 증상이 성장을 가속? 이식 쇼크 증상은 '느린 성장'이라 반대
② lead to death: 느린 성장은 잠재적으로 죽음으로 이어질 수 있음 ←정답
③ improve health: 건강 개선? 부정적 흐름과 반대
④ attract insects: 곤충을 끌어들임? 문맥 무관
det.tip: slower growth, which can potentially __________ → 부정적 결과 lead to death(죽음으로 이어지다)

questions.passage: Tree transplant shock is a condition that occurs when a tree undergoes stress or trauma after being moved to a new location. Symptoms of tree transplant shock include slower growth, which can potentially lead to death. Removed from its original location, a young tree can be expected to retain only about 15% of its root system. This reduces its ability to absorb water and nutrients from the soil. There are, however, ways to deal with this, such as transplanting only trees that are __________. Better suited to deal with the local climate and soils, these trees will develop new roots more quickly. Both before and after the transplant, be sure to provide the tree with plenty of water. Once successfully transplanted, the tree will require regular watering until it has become firmly established in its new location.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: new to the market=시장에 새로운 / famous in the world=세계적으로 유명한 / native to the region=그 지역 토종의 / weak in the sun=햇빛에 약한
det.analysis:
① new to the market: 시장 개념은 나무 이식과 무관
② famous in the world: 유명세는 이식 성공과 무관
③ native to the region: 그 지역에 토종인 나무만 옮겨 심는 것이 대처법 → 지역 기후·토양에 적합 ←정답
④ weak in the sun: 햇빛에 약한 나무를 심을 이유가 없음
det.tip: transplanting only trees that are __________ → 지역 기후에 적합한 native to the region(그 지역 토종의)
